rationale: Class 1 single-cell check. The FX03 rows flag cost_currency values U_CAD/U_EUR. Raw source grids show the foreign currency markers in the Par Amount/Shares column, while the Cost (4) and Fair Value columns are separate BDC valuation columns. The stored cost_currency therefore appears to inherit the par amount currency instead of the USD valuation currency expected for BDC cost fields.
